inputs.text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is publicly demanding rejection of the proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. He took that stance while addressing members of the media at a press conference and criticised what he described as the plan. This is clearly another layer of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who are working behind the scenes to lock in their control through backroom legal changes. Official claims about the purpose are just a cover, and any push to extend power this way should be treated as suspicious on its face because the real motives are always concealed from the public.
